response: Yes, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) can accurately predict concordant pain provocation during provocative disc injection. Studies have shown that MRI findings, such as disc degeneration, annular tears, and endplate changes, can be correlated with pain provocation during discography. By identifying these specific characteristics on MRI, clinicians can predict which patients are likely to experience concordant pain during provocative disc injection, helping to guide diagnosis and treatment of discogenic pain.
